change_summary: Kerr leg (SKS N=1, a=0.9375) ray comparison at C=80 with the literal dag.md thresholds
expected: max|x_R-x_B|<=1e-3 on escaped rays, escape angle<=1e-6, |k.k|/k_t^2<=1e-8 on every ray at C=80
observed: class 100% identical, order 4.0/3.8 (RAPTOR) 4.0/4.0 (BLP); max|dx| 3.9e-3 and angle 2.3e-6 only on near-critical rays (grid/random: 2.3e-5, 2.6e-8); null norm escaped rays 1.6e-8 RAPTOR vs 2.3e-8 BLP, capture tail (E_n>10) 0.14 RAPTOR vs 0.025 BLP
root_cause: RK4 discretisation at C=80: on near-critical rays each code's own error vs the Vern7 reference is 3.2e-3 (RAPTOR) / 7e-4 (BLP) and |dx|/(2 max eps) <= 0.84 on every ray; BLP's own null drift exceeds 1e-8 on escaped rays; capture-tail drift at E_n>10 in both codes
fix_hypothesis: Evaluate with the design.md section 5 attribution rule (|X_R-X_B| <= 2 max(eps_R, eps_B)) and the literal thresholds at C=160; report the capture-tail null drift separately

change_summary: All three legs with the section-5 attribution evaluation (first version of the comparison script)
expected: dx and escape angle within 2 max(eps_R, eps_B) of each code's own error against the Vern7 reference
observed: dx/(2 eps) 2.1-3.7 on s455/s122; angle ratio ~1e300; s455 had 1 near-critical ray instead of 50
root_cause: comparison-script defects: states compared at equal step index while lambda_R and lambda_B differ by up to 3e-3 (steps follow the state); acos(dot) cannot resolve angles below 1.5e-8 so reference angles rounded to 0; the far hole's shadow is displaced by the companion's lensing so its projected centre is not captured
fix_hypothesis: compare at equal lambda (move the RAPTOR state by -k dlambda), angle via atan(|u x v|, u.v), seed the critical-curve bisection from a captured grid point near each projected centre
